svg.title: The square at the bottom of the hill, half past eight
svg.desc: A city square early in the morning with a metro entrance, a tram stop, a bus stop, a pharmacy on the corner, a church and a steep street going up out of the picture, with one person standing in the middle turning round with a phone.

g.text: The square at the bottom of the hill, half past eight
Fourteen things to find. There are four ways out of this square and three of them look the same.
the church - on the corner, and the first landmark
the hotel - and the bank next to it
the street going up - out of the picture
the metro entrance - four minutes underground
the man at the pharmacy door
one person, turning round, with a phone
two people waiting for the tram
and neither of them is going up the hill
the bus stop - on the wrong side of the square
somebody who knows the way, walking fast
